meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 03 of 2021, adopting the Final Budget for Fiscal Year 2021-22 of the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority.
votes.description: Adopts the LBA's FY2021-22 Capital Projects Fund budget, which covers bond debt services for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and Convene as the Redevelopment Agency.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA meeting and transition to the RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2021, amending the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 final budget of the Redevelopment Agency as proposed by the Administration with the Granary District Community & Cultural Initiative funding going into a holding account.
votes.description: Amends the RDA's FY2020-21 budget to adjust property tax increment revenues and fund various district projects, with Granary District funds placed in a holding account pending further Board review.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 12 of 2021, approving the FY22 RDA Budget reflected in the attached Key Changes spreadsheet with the clarifications shown on the motion sheet, with specified capital projects approved that do not lapse to Fund Balance.
votes.description: Adopts the RDA's FY2021-22 annual budget with approximately $2.9 million in capital projects placed in various holding accounts pending specific project proposals.

votes.motion: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined on the motion sheet under Motion 2, items A and B, relating to energy efficiency as a condition of RDA project loans and investments, and reviewing the structure of RDA accounts.
votes.description: Establishes legislative intent for the RDA to require energy efficiency standards for project loans/investments and to review all RDA account structures including fund balances and prior capital projects.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Redevelopment Agency and convene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the RDA meeting and transition to the City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the Work Session meeting minutes for February 16, 2021; Formal meeting minutes for February 2, 2021 and February 16, 2021.
votes.description: Approves the official minutes for the February 2021 work session and formal City Council meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 22 of 2021, recognizing June 19th as Juneteenth day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall officially recognizing June 19, 2021 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items G-1 through G-8 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing for eight grant applications and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 24 of 2021, amending the final budget for the Library Fund for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2020, and ending June 30, 2021.
votes.description: Amends the Library Fund FY2020-21 budget to account for pass-through property tax revenue collected by Salt Lake County going to the Utah Inland Port Authority and the Convention Facility.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 25 of 2021, amending the FY 2020-2021 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document as shown on the motion sheet.
votes.description: Amends the City's FY2020-21 final budget with various adjustments including Emergency Management office build-out, 911 technology upgrades, Fire Department reimbursements, and ARPA-related items.

votes.motion: Motion 1: Adopt Ordinance 32 of 2021, approving Salt Lake City's Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget as outlined in the attached key changes spreadsheets and staffing document, excluding the schedule for capital projects and debt and the Library Fund.
votes.description: Adopts the main City operating budget for FY2021-22, excluding the Library Fund and the CIP/debt schedule.

votes.motion: Motion 2: Adopt Ordinance 33 of 2021 approving the budget for the Library Fund of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
votes.description: Adopts the Library Fund budget for FY2021-22 as a separate ordinance.

votes.motion: Motion 3: Adopt Ordinance 34 of 2021 setting the final rate of tax levy, including the final levy for the Library Fund, for Fiscal Year 2021-22 at .004076 on each dollar of taxable valuation.
votes.description: Sets the FY2021-22 property tax rates for the General Fund, judgment levy, General Obligation Bonds, and Library Fund.

votes.motion: Motion 4: Adopt $37,355,406 to be transferred into CIP, including approving $8,572,651 in funding for annual debt service and other ongoing commitments, as detailed in the Mayor's Recommended CIP Budget excluding the first year payment for the proposed new sales tax Series 2022 bond.
votes.description: Approves the CIP transfer and debt service commitments for FY2021-22, deferring the proposed new bond's first-year payment to a later Council decision.

votes.motion: Motion 5: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined on the motion sheet under Motion 5, items A through E.
votes.description: Adopts five legislative intent statements related to boarded-building fees, Trips-to-Transit expansion, Golf Fund updates, Funding Our Future definition expansion, and Public Lands maintenance funding estimates.

votes.motion: Motion 6: Adopt ordinances A through F relating to the Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget, including Ordinances 26-31 of 2021 covering AFSCME appropriations, Firefighters MOU appropriations, Police Association appropriations, non-represented employee compensation plan, public right-of-way amendments, and organizational changes.
votes.description: Adopts six budget-related ordinances covering labor MOU funding appropriations, compensation plans, public way fee amendments, and City departmental reorganization for FY2021-22.
Approves consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for rezones, board appointments, and a fee schedule public hearing date.
